fact: The Ministry of Social Solidarity has rebuilt the Takaful and Karama system as an integrated digital system in which social workers record household data on tablets and applicants are verified through network links to government bodies.
title: التضامن: التحول الرقمي يطور منظومة «تكافل وكرامة» لضمان وصول الدعم إلى مستحقيه
